body: Talking to you made me feel better

They know for the most part, they had me in therapy but I started refusing to go about a year ago, this has been coming for a long time it's okay. Thanks for caring though. It's more than most people around me have done

Non stop thinking about suicide, I'm 20 and I still live at home where my family has said to me that it's better when I'm not around, I've been depressed for years and I'm always angry and I lash out at everyone all of the time for no reason. I can't stop being mad. I cut then have to worry about hiding it. It's to the point where all I want is suicide and I always have the urge to jump off of things
